heading_en: Counter-Guarantees, etc. by Central Governments, etc. or Japanese Local Governments
summary_ja: 中央政府等・地方公共団体が再保証（又はその他の信用補完）を行う保証を、関連債務の包含、適格要件、履行の確実性等の条件の下で中央政府等による保証として扱える。
summary_en: A guarantee counter-guaranteed (or otherwise credit-enhanced) by a sovereign or Japanese local government may be treated as sovereign-guaranteed if the counter-guarantee covers all related obligations, both layers are eligible, and performance is reliable.
paragraphs: Where a central government, etc. or a local government in Japan provides a counter-guarantee for a guarantee of an exposure, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach may treat that guarantee as one by the central government, etc. or local government in Japan only where the conditions listed in the following items are satisfied. (i) That the counter-guarantee by the central government, etc. or local government in Japan also covers the related obligations other than principal among the obligations covered by the guarantee. (ii) That the guarantee of the exposure and the counter-guarantee by the central government, etc. or local government in Japan each satisfy all of the eligibility requirements for guarantees; provided, however, that the counter-guarantee by the central government, etc. or local government in Japan is not required to satisfy the requirements of Article 94, items (i) and (ii). (iii) That there is no problem with the certainty of performance of the counter-guarantee by the central government, etc. or local government in Japan, and there is no past record indicating that the coverage of the guarantee is narrower than where the central government, etc. or local government in Japan guarantees directly.

The provisions of the preceding paragraph shall apply mutatis mutandis where the credit risk mitigation effect is to be taken into account using credit enhancement provided by a central government, etc. or local government in Japan in a form other than a counter-guarantee. In this case, the term "counter-guarantee" in that paragraph shall be read as "credit enhancement provided in a form other than a counter-guarantee", and in item (iii) of that paragraph, the term "guarantees directly" shall be read as "provides credit enhancement directly", and the term "the coverage of the guarantee" shall be read as "the scope in which credit enhancement is provided".
